notes: Root-cause fix for the empty Assignment tab: the portal now reads msspId from the same source the backend writes to (Deployment singleton). Previously it preferred the BASEWISER_MSSP_ID env var, which resolved to a different value on this deployment — backend wrote bundle rows to partition A, portal queried partition B, the two never met. After this release the diagnostic chip should turn green ('Synced 3 · portal sees 3 bundles') and the Assignment tab should finally surface the Assign dropdowns
Diagnostic chip now also calls out msspId divergence explicitly ('portal=X ≠ backend=Y') if it ever drifts again
